## Cost analysis

612 = memory 500 (color0_crop F32 **400** + signed_state_u8 U8 **100**) + params 112 (Wq[10,1,3,3]=90 + Bq[10]=10 + starts4/ends4=8 + 4 quant scalars). Every component is forced (see hard_record). The 400 B F32 crop is NOT a formulation artifact: any op reading the F32 `input` charges its output; the minimal spatial crop of F32 = 100 elem × 4 B = 400. Casting to U8 (Quantize/Cast) is elementwise → same shape → cannot delete the already-charged F32 crop. Avoiding the F32 crop by casting the WHOLE input first = 9100 B (proto `task331_castfull_u8slice.onnx`, score_v2 9212). U8 crop (100) is forced by QLinearConv's U8-input requirement (the only free-U8-output render).
